results.criterion: Starting from the authorised V4 launcher at `/launcher`, the page visibly shows both the GIS and API Request Audit module cards, and each card has an Open control.
steps_taken: Navigated to the exact authorised launcher URL and waited for the visible launcher.
Captured the initial launcher and inspected GIS and API request audit cards, their arrow Open controls and accessible button names.
Captured a separate final image and read the browser URL; no state-changing action was needed for this visibility assertion.
results.reason: Both module cards and their Open controls were visible on the authorised launcher.

results.criterion: From the authorised launcher, activating the API Request Audit Open control navigates to a non-error audit page that visibly contains identifiable audit content, such as request metrics or the `Requests and errors over time` chart.
steps_taken: Navigated independently to the exact launcher URL and captured the initial launcher.
Captured before opening API request audit, then activated its Open control.
Waited for Requests and errors over time; observed request metrics (370 requests, 0.3% error rate, 3 callers) and the rendered chart.
Captured after opening and a separate final audit image, then read the actual browser URL.
Returned to the launcher by navigation to start the next independent criterion; no audit filters or records were changed.
results.reason: The audit destination displayed identifiable metrics and a chart without a sign-in or application error page.

results.criterion: After opening API Request Audit, using the browser Back control returns to the launcher, where the GIS module card and its Open control are visibly available.
steps_taken: Navigated independently to the exact launcher URL and captured its initial state.
Captured before opening API request audit and activated its Open control.
Waited for the visible audit chart, then captured the audit state and the state before Browser Back.
Used Browser Back and waited for the visible launcher heading.
Verified GIS and its Open control were available; captured after Back and a separate final launcher image, then read the browser URL.
results.reason: Browser Back returned exactly to /launcher, with GIS and its Open control available.

results.criterion: From the returned launcher, activating the GIS Open control navigates to a settled GIS map view with visible map controls.
steps_taken: Navigated independently to the exact launcher URL and captured its initial state.
Captured before opening API request audit, activated its Open control, waited for the visible chart and captured the audit state.
Captured before Browser Back, used Browser Back and waited for the visible launcher.
Verified and read the returned /launcher URL; captured after Back and immediately before opening GIS.
Activated GIS Open from that returned launcher; waited for map rendering to settle.
Observed rendered streets, place labels, map search, north reset, map style and zoom controls; captured after opening and a separate final GIS image, then read the browser URL.
Used Browser Back to finish on the launcher and captured cleanup separately. No layers, filters, selections or records were changed.
results.reason: A settled street map and visible map controls were present at /gis. The restored Coverage Gap Candidate Areas layer displayed 'Unable to load coverage gap candidate areas' in its existing side panel; its data could not be inspected, but layer data is outside this navigation-only criterion. The layer and panel were left untouched.

conciseReport: All four navigation criteria passed with independent launcher starts and criterion-owned PNG evidence. API request audit showed metrics and the requests/errors chart; Browser Back returned exactly to /launcher; GIS displayed a settled street map and map controls at /gis. The existing Coverage Gap Candidate Areas panel showed a data-loading error, outside the navigation scope. Finished on the launcher without changing filters, layers or records. No material navigation guidance gap was exposed; no guide changes were staged.
reason: Testing completed; awaiting independent evidence review. Existing GIS coverage gap candidate data was unavailable, as noted in criterion 4.
